commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) finds himself unmarked on the edge of the box, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Elche.
90+1' Osasuna are ruled offside.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
88' The attendance for today's match is 21253.

86' Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) in a great chance! He climbs highest deep in the penalty box and strikes with a powerful header towards the net. Next time he should aim better. His effort ends wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Osasuna.
86' The substitution has been made. Abel Bretones (Osasuna) has replaced Ruben Garcia.
85' Today's match ends for Andre Silva who will be replaced by Rafa Mir (Elche).
85' Eder Sarabia has decided to substitute Tete Morente and he is replaced by Yago Santiago (Elche).
85' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) goes into the book and receives a yellow card.
82' John Donald (Elche) unleashes a shot towards the goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies high over the bar.
82' 4:2 – this is the current number of shots on target.
80' Substitution. Lucas Cepeda did his best and is replaced by Martim Neto (Elche).
80' Eder Sarabia prepares a substitution. Marc Aguado is replaced by John Donald (Elche).
79' Tete Morente (Elche) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
78' Elche will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
78' Lucas Cepeda (Elche) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
75' Valentin Rosier (Osasuna) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
74' The manager makes a subsitution with Raul Garcia (Osasuna) coming on for Ante Budimir.
73' Lucas Cepeda (Elche) tries to threaten the goalkeeper as he takes the ball and fires from long range. The shot flies just over the crossbar!
73' That's a clear yellow card. Asier Osambela (Osasuna) goes into the book.
72' Corner kick. Elche will have an opportunity.
72' Aleix Febas (Elche) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. The ball is out of play and Elche manage to earn a corner.
70' The ball goes out for a corner. Elche can continue in their attacking effort.
67' Substitution. Raul Moro replaces Victor Munoz (Osasuna).
66' Alessio Lisci has decided to make a change. Asier Osambela (Osasuna) replaces Lucas Torro.
66' Iker Munoz will be replaced by Jon Moncayola (Osasuna).
66' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Elche comes to nothing.
62' PENALTY APPEAL by Osasuna, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
61' The referee points to the corner flag and Elche will take a corner.
60' Now Elche have a corner.
56' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
53' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) is cautioned by the referee, who shows him a yellow card.

52' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
52' Tete Morente (Elche) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Jose Sanchez blows for a foul.
51' Sergio Herrera pulls off a great save to deny Andre Silva (Elche), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom right corner.
50' A corner kick by Elche is thwarted by the well prepared Sergio Herrera (Osasuna).
49' Tete Morente (Elche) forces a pass into the box, but Sergio Herrera is alert and does a great job to rob him of the ball.
48' Osasuna get a corner.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+1' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
43' The free kick from long range, taken by Elche, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.

42' Valentin Rosier (Osasuna) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Jose Sanchez no option but to blow his whistle. Elche will take a free kick.
37' The referee is firm and issues Ante Budimir (Osasuna) a deserved yellow card.
37' Marc Aguado (Elche) receives a yellow card.
36' Elche win a corner.
36' Lucas Cepeda (Elche) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Elche have been awarded a corner kick.

33' That didn't go as planned! Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the bottom right corner was too weak to get past Matias Dituro, who easily kept it out.
33' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
32' German Valera (Elche) makes a strong challenge and Jose Sanchez blows for a foul. Osasuna have a free kick.
31' Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) takes a short pass in his stride inside the box, but hits a poor shot at goal that goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Osasuna will have a goal kick.
29' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
26' Elche failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
24' Iker Munoz (Osasuna) makes a rough challenge and Jose Sanchez blows his whistle for a foul.
21' The ball goes out of play. Elche are awarded a corner kick.
19' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the middle of the target, but Matias Dituro easily deals with the threat.
18' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
17' Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
13' One of the players from Osasuna times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
7' Victor Chust (Elche) has a sight of goal and shoots from distance, but Sergio Herrera is equal to it.
6' Jorge Herrando (Osasuna) is penalised for holding. Jose Sanchez signals a set piece.
4' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Matias Dituro, who smothers the ball.

3' The defence just can't clear the ball and a rebound eventually falls to Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) deep inside the box, but his well-hit shot flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Osasuna.

2' Lucas Cepeda (Elche) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the right post is blocked by Sergio Herrera, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Osasuna will take the kick-off.
